title: Bostick on strange effects at high megavoltage

tellings.quote: Bostick is quoted as saying strange things happen at high mega voltage across short distances.

plain: A man named Bostick is quoted as saying that "strange things happen at high mega voltage across short distances", meaning when millions of volts are packed into a small gap. Michels tells this himself as something he has read, linking it to the inventor Thomas Townsend Brown, who worked with high voltages. If true, it would hint that powerful electricity can produce effects that ordinary physics does not expect.
